text_block_list.text:
All of Симболи Рудольф's races have been
run. With
seven crowns to her name, she
has proven beyond
all doubt that she is
truly the Emperor.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The weight hangs heavy, but she is
strong enough
to bear it. We both
celebrate the fulfillment of
our shared
dream.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
